## Research

**Financial Literacy in Bangalore Gig Workers — Sole author and field researcher (2026)**  
Designed and conducted primary research with 40 security guards; analysed predictors of financial literacy using Bayesian logistic regression. Sole-authored empirical paper available on SSRN with DOI.

**Economics literature review — Author (2026–)**  
Developing a structured literature review for eventual SSRN submission.

## Entrepreneurship, software, and finance

**Systematick — Founder and builder (2025–)**  
Building a programmable investment-screening platform focused on transparent, repeatable decision processes and reliable historical data.

**ICICI Direct trading system — Designer and developer (2024)**  
Built a recommendation-ingestion and order-execution pipeline with a manual review and override interface.

**Vernacular financial-access prototype — Proof-of-concept developer (2024–25)**  
Developed and deployed a multilingual chatbot prototype after working alongside researchers exploring language-first access to financial information.
